description: This Scala source file defines a Spark optimization rule 'CoalesceBucketsInJoin' that coalesces bucketed join sides in Spark SQL plans for specific join types, primarily 'SortMergeJoin' and 'ShuffledHashJoin'. It includes logic for identifying applicable joins, checking bucket divisibility, and updating plan nodes to optimize bucket usage during joins.

classes.name: CoalesceBucketsInJoin
classes.description: A Spark optimization rule that coalesces bucketed join sides to optimize join performance based on bucket divisibility and configuration settings.

classes.name: ExtractJoinWithBuckets
classes.description: An extractor object that identifies applicable bucketed joins with specific properties, such as both sides being bucketed and having divisible bucket counts.

methods.name: updateNumCoalescedBucketsInScan
methods.description: Updates the optional number of coalesced buckets in a FileSourceScanExec plan node.

methods.name: updateNumCoalescedBuckets
methods.description: Creates a new join plan with updated coalesced bucket counts on either the left or right side.

methods.name: isCoalesceSHJStreamSide
methods.description: Determines if the join is on the stream side of a ShuffledHashJoinExec based on bucket counts.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Main method applying the coalescing rule to a SparkPlan, modifying join plans when conditions are met.

methods.name: hasScanOperation
methods.description: Recursively checks if a plan contains only scan operations, used to identify eligible join plans.

methods.name: getBucketSpec
methods.description: Extracts the BucketSpec from a plan node if available.

methods.name: satisfiesOutputPartitioning
methods.description: Checks if join keys match the output partitioning of a plan, ensuring join compatibility.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Determines if a join plan is suitable for bucket coalescing based on scan operations and partitioning.

methods.name: isDivisible
methods.description: Checks if two bucket counts are divisible, a prerequisite for coalescing buckets.

methods.name: unapply
methods.description: Extracts join plan and bucket counts if the plan is a suitable shuffled join with divisible bucket counts.
